subject: Marketplace listing telemetry and SKU tagging for syndicated ISV bundles
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cloudworks.io>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: marketplace@cloudworks.io
Date: 2028-09-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing telemetry and SKU tagging for syndicated ISV bundles

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the time on Friday. CloudWorks is preparing the first wave of syndicated ISV bundles for AWS/GCP/Azure listings and we want to align on the telemetry and SKU tagging schema so analytics and rev attribution are clean on both sides. High-level asks below: 

- SKU taxonomy: we currently publish a single bundle SKU today, but need to map to per-feature SKUs for co-sell attribution. Can you share Redwood's preferred column mapping?
- Metering signals: what event granularity do you need (tokens, sessions, API call types) to reconcile usage and revenue?
- Evidence: any marketplace-specific artifacts (metering JSON, telemetry contract) we should attach to the listing?

We want to move quickly — target is to have a working SKU map and a minimal evidence package in two weeks so we can hit the Oct 1 catalog refresh. Attaching our internal outline.

Attachments: partner_metering_spec.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Daniel Cho
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudWorks
From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cloudworks.io>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing telemetry and SKU tagging for syndicated ISV bundles

On 9/12/28 10:02 AM, Daniel Cho wrote:
> Thanks again for the time on Friday. CloudWorks is preparing the first wave of syndicated ISV bundles ...

Daniel — good to see this moving. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

- SKU mapping: please send a CSV with product_feature_code, human_label, suggested_price_key. I've attached a small example (example_sku_map.csv) with how Redwood maps bundle -> feature SKUs for co-sell attribution.
- Metering: token-level and session-start/stop events are ideal. For reconciliation we prefer: token_count (per request), call_type (chat/generate/embed), timestamp, model_variant, customer_tenant_id. If you cannot provide token_count, we can accept per-request byte estimates as an interim.
- Marketplace evidence: schema_v1.json (we'll provide) plus a short evidence_guide.pdf listing the files marketplaces typically require (metering hooks, sample logs, S3 retention proofs).

Action items: 
1) Daniel: share a raw SKU export (CSV) from CloudWorks by EOD 9/15.
2) Olga (cc'd): we'll need the schema and an evidence checklist we can hand to your product ops team.
3) Naomi (cc'd): can you confirm any regional/contract tags we need (US vs EU) for the listing?

If we get the CSV, Olga and I will produce a mapping and a short mutual action plan (MAP) by 9/18.

Cheers,
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cloudworks.io>, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: 2028-09-15T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing telemetry and SKU tagging for syndicated ISV bundles

Ben / Daniel — looping in the technical evidence checklist and a first-pass schema. See attachments.

Key technical notes (summary):
- Attached schema_v1.json is the minimal JSON envelope marketplaces require: {event_type, customer_id, timestamp, tokens, model, sku_id, usage_unit}. We recommend sending a daily batch file and a streaming endpoint for higher-volume customers.
- For SKU mapping, use the example_sku_map.csv format Ben attached. Important columns: external_bundle_id, redwood_sku_id, feature_label, pricing_tier. Avoid free-text fields in the SKU label to keep marketplace search clean.
- Retention proof: marketplaces often ask for 90-day logs and an S3 bucket access snapshot. We'll provide an evidence_guide.pdf with exact filenames and an s3:// path template.

Attachments included (stubs): schema_v1.json, evidence_guide.pdf

DocuSign: Ben and I discussed a short MOU for revenue sharing & metering responsibilities. I uploaded a preliminary envelope to DocuSign here: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/--/envelope/0a1b2c3d — please review. Once we have mapped SKUs and confirm metering fields we'll route the MOU to CloudWorks legal.

Naomi — for region tags, we need a short note on whether CloudWorks will publish separate SKUs for EU regions (data residency). If yes, we'll mark region=eu for those SKUs.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Principal Product Manager, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cloudworks.io>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com, procure@enterprisekite.com
Date: 2028-09-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing telemetry and SKU tagging for syndicated ISV bundles

Thanks — this is great. We've pulled the CSV export and attached our raw SKU file (partner_metering_spec.xlsx). A few notes: 

- Procurement (cc'd) will handle the MOU review. Procurement contact is Lina Park at EnterpriseKite and she is on cc.
- We will publish separate EU SKUs for customers in EU regions, so please mark those with region=eu during the mapping.
- Timeline: CloudWorks can deliver cleaned SKU CSV and initial metering endpoint by 9/27. We request Redwood produce the mapped SKU file and the evidence bundle by 10/04 so we can submit the listing before Oct 8.

Next steps agreed:
1) CloudWorks: deliver cleaned CSV and API access test account (credentials will follow) by 9/27.
2) Redwood (Olga/Ben): map SKUs, produce evidence bundle, and route MOU by 10/04.
3) Procurement/legal: review MOU once DocuSign is routed.

Attachments: partner_metering_spec.xlsx (raw)

Looking forward — will keep procurement looped.

Best,
Daniel Cho
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudWorks
